Header.title: Building Management System
Header.paragraph: A Building Management System (BMS) is a comprehensive software solution designed to streamline and automate the management of residential, commercial, or mixed-use properties. The goal of a BMS is to enhance operational efficiency, improve tenant satisfaction, and facilitate effective property management.
